## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(leaflet)
library(tmap)
library(tidyverse)
library(tigris)
library(arcgislayers)
library(foreign)
library(osrm)
library(readxl)
library(htmlwidgets)

library(exactextractr)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

setwd("/Users/madelinepierce/Dropbox/Mac/Desktop/Summer/GIS")

#  Base map 
maine <- states(cb = TRUE) |>
  filter(STUSPS == "ME") |>
  st_transform(4326)

# Roads 
furl  <- "https://gis.maine.gov/mapservices/rest/services/dot/MaineDOT_OpenData/MapServer/52"
roads <- arc_select(arc_open(furl))

# Mills
mills_sf <- read_excel("Mills_Price.xlsx") |>
  mutate(
    raw_stumpage_value = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", `Price (Spruce & Fir)`)),
    product_type        = Type
  ) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("LON", "LAT"), crs = 4326) |>
  mutate(mill_id = row_number())

# Rasters 
index  <- rast("sbw_susc_index_2022_240m.tif")
share  <- rast("sbw_spruce_fir_share_2022_240m.tif")

conserve <- st_read("Maine_Conserved_Lands/Maine_Conserved_Lands.shp")

conserve_noharvest <- conserve |>
  filter(grepl("^1-|^2-", GAP_STATUS))

conserve_mask <- rasterize(
  vect(conserve_noharvest) |> project(crs(index)),
  index,
  field = 1
)

index_harvest <- index |>
  mask(conserve_mask, inverse = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

stumpage_by_county <- c(
  "AROOSTOOK"    = 30,
  "PISCATAQUIS"  = 43,
  "PENOBSCOT"    = 33,
  "WASHINGTON"   = 26,
  "HANCOCK"      = 31,
  "SOMERSET"     = 23,
  "FRANKLIN"     = 40,
  "OXFORD"       = 36,
  "KENNEBEC"     = 32,
  "KNOX"         = 32,
  "LINCOLN"      = 32,
  "WALDO"        = 32,
  "ANDROSCOGGIN" = 23,
  "CUMBERLAND"   = 23,
  "SAGADAHOC"    = 23,
  "YORK"         = 23
)

counties_me <- counties(state = "ME", cb = TRUE) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  select(NAME, geometry)

county_idx      <- st_nearest_feature(mills_sf, counties_me)
mills_sf$county <- counties_me$NAME[county_idx]

mills_sf <- mills_sf |>
  mutate(
    county_upper = toupper(county),
    stumpage = case_when(
      product_type == "Sawlog"   ~ replace_na(stumpage_by_county[county_upper], 23),
      product_type == "Pulpwood" ~ raw_stumpage_value,
      TRUE                       ~ NA_real_
    ),
    price_delivered = case_when(
      product_type == "Sawlog"   ~ stumpage / 0.33,
      product_type == "Pulpwood" ~ stumpage / 0.28,
      TRUE                       ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# Haul time function 

compute_haul_time <- function(p,
                               stumpage      = 10,
                               harvest_pct   = 0.33,
                               truck_tons    = 18.9,
                               trucking_rate = 90,
                               load_unload   = 40) {
  net_per_ton    <- p - (harvest_pct * p) - stumpage
  load_value     <- net_per_ton * truck_tons
  round_trip_hrs <- load_value / trucking_rate
  one_way_min    <- (round_trip_hrs * 60 - load_unload) * 0.5
  return(one_way_min)
}

whalley_benchmark_gt <- 5 
delivered_cost_target_gt <- 30 

## Table 1 defaults
cf_mhr  <- 60
cf_kgt  <- 1000
rho     <- 961

dbh   <- 20
ds    <- 305
vtsb  <- 5
vt    <- 0.3
nt    <- 35600
f_hr  <- 0.40
f_b   <- 0.23
f_br  <- 0.55
f_hw  <- 0.4
p_lc  <- 0.10

## Table 2 machine costs, $/PMH
c_fb <- 123
c_gs <- 103
c_sd <- 131
c_ch <- 179
p_c  <- 48

## Stem count per accumulation, based on DBH
stem_count <- dplyr::case_when(
  dbh < 10             ~ 5,
  dbh >= 10 & dbh <= 18 ~ 3,
  dbh > 18             ~ 1
)
sum_dbh <- dbh * stem_count

## Eq. 2.1: Feller buncher productivity (m3/PMH)
p_fb <- cf_mhr * (1 / exp(-0.888 + 0.136*stem_count + 0.017*sum_dbh)) * vt * stem_count

## Eq. 2.2: Grapple skidder productivity (m3/PMH) - CORRECTED, see note above
p_gs <- exp(2.632 - 0.002*ds + 0.314*vtsb)

## Eq. 2.4a/2.4b/2.5: Stroke delimber productivity, HW/SW weighted
p_sd_hw <- (-0.708 + 0.219*dbh)^2
p_sd_sw <- (-0.058 + 0.219*dbh)^2
p_sd    <- p_sd_hw*f_hw + p_sd_sw*(1 - f_hw)

## Eq. 2.6-2.10: Stand harvest volumes/masses
n_th <- nt * f_hr
v_th <- vt * (1 - f_b) * n_th
m_th <- v_th * rho / cf_kgt
v_bh <- f_b * f_br * vt * n_th
m_bh <- v_bh * rho / cf_kgt

## Eq. 2.11-2.12: Per-machine cost per volume, per area (FB/GS/SD only)
c_fb_v <- c_fb / p_fb;  c_fb_a <- c_fb_v * vt * n_th
c_gs_v <- c_gs / p_gs;  c_gs_a <- c_gs_v * vt * n_th
c_sd_v <- c_sd / p_sd;  c_sd_a <- c_sd_v * vt * n_th

## Chipper: mass-basis conversion
c_ch_v <- c_ch / p_c
c_ch_a <- c_ch_v * m_bh

## Eq. 2.14-2.17: Fractions
v_h  <- v_th + v_bh
m_h  <- m_th + m_bh
f_th <- v_th / v_h
f_bh <- m_bh / m_h

## Eq. 2.19: Proportioned biomass harvest cost (no profit yet)
c_bhp <- ((c_fb_a + c_gs_a + c_sd_a) * f_bh + c_ch_a) / m_bh

## Logger profit as its own term 
logger_profit_gt <- c_bhp * p_lc
c_bhp_with_profit <- c_bhp + logger_profit_gt  

cat(sprintf("\nC_BHp (harvest cost, no profit): $%.2f/GT\n", c_bhp))
cat(sprintf("Logger profit: $%.2f/GT\n", logger_profit_gt))



## Trucking cost components 
e_f   <- 1.786
c_rm  <- 0.23
c_pi  <- 0.21
c_til <- 0.05
c_a   <- 0.07
p_tr  <- 0.02
m_tr  <- 32

avg_truck_speed_kmh <- 80.47

## Firm-specific inputs
biomass_firms <- tibble::tribble(
  ~name,                                              ~county,        ~stumpage, ~p_d_gal, ~c_l,
  "TIMBERHP / GO LAB MADISON FACILITY",                "Somerset",     2,         5.132,    0.4841,
  "MAINE WOODS PELLET COMPANY LLC",                    "Somerset",     2,         5.132,    0.4841,
  "NORTHEAST PELLETS LLC",                             "Aroostook",    2,         5.181,    0.4790,
  "LIGNETICS OF MAINE / GENEVA WOOD FUELS",            "Franklin",     2,         5.193,    0.5171,
  "REGENERATE LIVERMORE FALLS (FORMERLY REENERGY)",    "Androscoggin", 1,         5.099,    0.5567,
  "REGENERATE / REENERGY STRATTON",                    "Franklin",     2,         5.193,    0.5171
)


biomass_firms <- biomass_firms |>
  mutate(
    p_d_liter          = p_d_gal / 3.785,
    r_per_km           = (p_d_liter / e_f) + c_l + c_rm + c_pi + c_til + c_a + p_tr,
    r_per_gt_km        = r_per_km / m_tr,
    transport_budget_gt = delivered_cost_target_gt - stumpage - c_bhp - logger_profit_gt,
    d_tr_km            = transport_budget_gt / r_per_gt_km,
    one_way_km         = d_tr_km / 2,
    haul_time_min      = (one_way_km / avg_truck_speed_kmh) * 60
  )

print(biomass_firms, width = Inf)

cat(sprintf("\nWhalley benchmark transport budget: $%.2f/GT (sanity check reference)\n",
            whalley_benchmark_gt))

## Fallback for biomass
default_stumpage <- 2
default_c_l  <- 0.5742
default_p_d  <- 1.379
default_r_per_km       <- (default_p_d/e_f) + default_c_l + c_rm + c_pi + c_til + c_a + p_tr
default_r_per_gt_km    <- default_r_per_km / m_tr
default_transport_budget_gt <- delivered_cost_target_gt - default_stumpage - c_bhp - logger_profit_gt
default_d_tr_km        <- default_transport_budget_gt / default_r_per_gt_km
default_one_way_km     <- default_d_tr_km / 2
default_haul_time_min  <- (default_one_way_km / avg_truck_speed_kmh) * 60

cat(sprintf("Fallback (unmatched biomass mills): transport budget $%.2f/GT -> %.1f km round-trip -> %.1f min one-way\n",
            default_transport_budget_gt, default_d_tr_km, default_haul_time_min))

mills_sf <- mills_sf |>
  left_join(
    biomass_firms |> select(name, firm_stumpage = stumpage, firm_transport_budget_gt = transport_budget_gt,
                             firm_haul_time_min = haul_time_min),
    by = c("NAME" = "name")
  )



mills_sf <- mills_sf |>
  mutate(
    haul_time_raw = case_when(
      product_type == "Sawlog"   ~ compute_haul_time(
                                      price_delivered,
                                      stumpage      = stumpage,
                                      harvest_pct   = 0.33,
                                      truck_tons    = 18.9,
                                      trucking_rate = 90
                                    ),
      product_type == "Pulpwood" ~ compute_haul_time(
                                      price_delivered,
                                      stumpage      = stumpage,
                                      harvest_pct   = 0.32,
                                      truck_tons    = 33,
                                      trucking_rate = 78.15
                                    ),
      product_type == "Biomass"  ~ coalesce(firm_haul_time_min, default_haul_time_min),
      TRUE                       ~ default_haul_time_min
    ),
    uses_formula  = product_type %in% c("Sawlog", "Pulpwood") & haul_time_raw > 0,
    haul_time_min = if_else(haul_time_raw <= 0,
                            default_haul_time_min,
                            haul_time_raw)
  )

mills_sf |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(product_type, uses_formula) |>
  summarise(
    n         = n(),
    mean_haul = round(mean(haul_time_min), 1),
    min_haul  = round(min(haul_time_min), 1),
    max_haul  = round(max(haul_time_min), 1),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) |>
  print()

# Detailed per-mill check for Biomass specifically
mills_sf |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(product_type == "Biomass") |>
  select(NAME, county, firm_stumpage, firm_haul_time_min, haul_time_min) |>
  print()
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false

# Point R at local OSRM server (must have Docker server running in Terminal)
options(osrm.server = "http://localhost:5001/")
options(osrm.profile = "driving")

sheds_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(mills_sf)), function(i) {
  tryCatch({
    ht <- mills_sf$haul_time_min[i]
    if (!is.finite(ht) || ht <= 0) {
      message("Mill ", i, " (", mills_sf$NAME[i], ") skipped: invalid haul time")
      return(NULL)
    }
    iso <- osrmIsochrone(
      loc    = mills_sf[i, ],
      breaks = c(0, ht),
      n      = 500
    )
    iso$mill_id       <- i
    iso$mill_name     <- mills_sf$NAME[i]
    iso$mill_type     <- mills_sf$TYPE_NEW[i]
    iso$product_type  <- mills_sf$product_type[i]
    iso$price         <- mills_sf$price_delivered[i]
    iso$haul_time_min <- ht
    iso$uses_formula  <- mills_sf$uses_formula[i]
    iso
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Mill ", i, " (", mills_sf$NAME[i], ") failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  })
})

sheds_list <- sheds_list[!sapply(sheds_list, is.null)]
sheds      <- do.call(rbind, sheds_list) |> st_make_valid()

st_write(sheds, "sheds_priced.gpkg", delete_dsn = TRUE)


procurement_zone_sawlog  <- st_union(sheds[sheds$product_type == "Sawlog", ])
procurement_zone_pulp    <- st_union(sheds[sheds$product_type == "Pulpwood", ])
procurement_zone_biomass <- st_union(sheds[sheds$product_type == "Biomass", ])
procurement_zone_all     <- st_union(sheds)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

index_proj <- project(index_harvest, crs(sheds))
share_proj <- project(share, crs(sheds))

mills_sf <- mills_sf |>
  mutate(
    sbw_mean = sapply(mill_id, function(i) {
      s <- sheds[sheds$mill_id == i, ]
      if (nrow(s) == 0) return(NA)
      round(exact_extract(index_proj,
                          st_transform(s, crs(index_proj)), "mean"), 3)
    }),
    sbw_min = sapply(mill_id, function(i) {
      s <- sheds[sheds$mill_id == i, ]
      if (nrow(s) == 0) return(NA)
      round(exact_extract(index_proj,
                          st_transform(s, crs(index_proj)), "min"), 2)
    }),
    sbw_max = sapply(mill_id, function(i) {
      s <- sheds[sheds$mill_id == i, ]
      if (nrow(s) == 0) return(NA)
      round(exact_extract(index_proj,
                          st_transform(s, crs(index_proj)), "max"), 2)
    }),
    sbw_range     = paste0(sbw_min, " - ", sbw_max),
    # Spruce-fir share: mean fraction of forest composition that is
    # spruce-fir within each mill's own procurement shed 
    spruce_fir_share_mean = sapply(mill_id, function(i) {
      s <- sheds[sheds$mill_id == i, ]
      if (nrow(s) == 0) return(NA)
      round(exact_extract(share_proj,
                          st_transform(s, crs(share_proj)), "mean"), 3)
    }),
    shed_area_km2 = sapply(mill_id, function(i) {
      s <- sheds[sheds$mill_id == i, ]
      if (nrow(s) == 0) return(NA)
      round(as.numeric(st_area(st_transform(s, 32619))) / 1e6, 1)
    })
  )

mills_sf |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(product_type) |>
  summarise(
    n                    = n(),
    mean_sbw_index       = round(mean(sbw_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    mean_spruce_fir_share = round(mean(spruce_fir_share_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    mean_shed_area_km2   = round(mean(shed_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

# Stat Analysis 

## Analysis 1: High-risk acreage inside vs. outside procurement zones

risk_vals <- terra::values(index_harvest, na.rm = TRUE)
high_risk_threshold <- quantile(risk_vals, 0.75)
cat(sprintf("High-risk SBW index threshold (75th percentile): %.3f\n", high_risk_threshold))

high_risk <- index_harvest > high_risk_threshold
high_risk[high_risk == 0] <- NA

cell_area_km2 <- prod(res(index_harvest)) / 1e6

total_high_risk_km2 <- sum(terra::values(high_risk), na.rm = TRUE) * cell_area_km2
cat(sprintf("Total high-risk area (study-wide): %.1f km2\n\n", total_high_risk_km2))

zones <- list(
  Sawlog   = procurement_zone_sawlog,
  Pulpwood = procurement_zone_pulp,
  Biomass  = procurement_zone_biomass
)

high_risk_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(names(zones), function(nm) {
  zone <- st_transform(zones[[nm]], crs(high_risk))
  inside_km2 <- exact_extract(high_risk, zone, "sum") * cell_area_km2
  tibble(
    product_type            = nm,
    high_risk_inside_km2    = round(inside_km2, 1),
    high_risk_outside_km2   = round(total_high_risk_km2 - inside_km2, 1),
    pct_high_risk_captured  = round(100 * inside_km2 / total_high_risk_km2, 1)
  )
})

cat("High-risk acreage captured by product-type procurement zone:\n")
print(high_risk_summary)

all_zones_union <- zones |>
  purrr::map(~ st_transform(.x, crs(high_risk))) |>
  purrr::map(st_geometry) |>
  purrr::reduce(c) |>          # combine geometries from all three sf objects
  st_union() |>                # dissolve overlaps into one polygon
  st_sf(geometry = _)

combined_inside_km2 <- exact_extract(high_risk, all_zones_union, "sum") * cell_area_km2

combined_row <- tibble(
  product_type            = "All mill types combined",
  high_risk_inside_km2    = round(combined_inside_km2, 1),
  high_risk_outside_km2   = round(total_high_risk_km2 - combined_inside_km2, 1),
  pct_high_risk_captured  = round(100 * combined_inside_km2 / total_high_risk_km2, 1)
)

high_risk_summary <- bind_rows(high_risk_summary, combined_row)

cat("High-risk acreage captured by product-type procurement zone (with combined total):\n")
print(high_risk_summary)

## Analysis 2: Cross-product comparison of zone characteristics

comparison_table <- mills_sf |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(product_type) |>
  summarise(
    n_mills               = n(),
    mean_sbw_index        = round(mean(sbw_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    mean_spruce_fir_share = round(mean(spruce_fir_share_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    mean_shed_area_km2    = round(mean(shed_area_km2, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\nCross-product comparison of procurement zone characteristics:\n")
print(comparison_table)


cat("\nKruskal-Wallis test: SBW index by product type\n")
print(kruskal.test(sbw_mean ~ product_type, data = mills_sf))

cat("\nKruskal-Wallis test: spruce-fir share by product type\n")
print(kruskal.test(spruce_fir_share_mean ~ product_type, data = mills_sf))
```

index_wgs   <- terra::project(index_harvest, "EPSG:4326", method = "bilinear")
index_wgs_r <- raster::raster(index_wgs)  # leaflet needs {raster}, not {terra}


pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette   = "YlOrRd",
  domain    = raster::values(index_wgs_r),
  na.color  = "transparent"
)


mill_colors <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#ff9999", "#ffd700", "white"),
  levels  = c("Sawlog", "Pulpwood", "Biomass")
)


mills_geo <- st_transform(mills_sf, 4326)

m <- leaflet() |>
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") |>
  addRasterImage(index_wgs_r, colors = pal, opacity = 0.8) |>
  addLegend(
    pal      = pal,
    values   = raster::values(index_wgs_r),
    title    = "SBW Susceptibility Index",
    position = "bottomright"
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft",
    colors   = c("#ff9999", "#ffd700", "white"),
    labels   = c("Sawlog",
                 "Pulpwood",
                 "Biomass"),
    title    = "Mill type",
    opacity  = 1
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    data        = st_transform(procurement_zone_sawlog, 4326),
    color       = "black", weight = 1.5, dashArray = "5",
    fillOpacity = 0, group = "Sawlog zone (formula-derived)"
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    data        = st_transform(procurement_zone_pulp, 4326),
    color       = "#cc7a00", weight = 1.5, dashArray = "8",
    fillOpacity = 0, group = "Pulpwood zone (formula-derived)"
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    data        = st_transform(procurement_zone_biomass, 4326),
    color       = "gray50", weight = 1, dashArray = "3",
    fillOpacity = 0, group = "Biomass zone (fixed radius)"
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data        = mills_geo,
    radius      = 5,
    color       = "black",
    fillColor   = ~mill_colors(product_type),
    fillOpacity = 1,
    weight      = 1,
    layerId     = ~paste0("mill_", mill_id),
    popup       = ~paste0(
      "<b>", NAME, "</b><br>",
      "Town: ", TOWN, "<br>",
      "Type: ", TYPE_NEW, "<br>",
      "Product: ", product_type, "<br>",
      "Delivered price: $", price_delivered, "/ton<br>",
      "County stumpage: $", stumpage, "/ton<br>",
      ifelse(product_type == "Biomass" & !is.na(firm_stumpage),
             paste0("Firm-specific stumpage: $", firm_stumpage, "/GT<br>",
                    "Residual transport budget: $", round(firm_transport_budget_gt, 2), "/GT<br>"),
             ""),
      "Haul time: ", round(haul_time_min, 1), " min",
      ifelse(uses_formula,
             " (formula-derived)",
             " (formula-derived)"), "<br>",
      "SBW index mean: ", sbw_mean, "<br>",
      "SBW index range: ", sbw_range, "<br>",
      "Spruce-fir share (shed mean): ", sprintf("%.1f%%", spruce_fir_share_mean * 100), "<br>",
      "Shed area: ", shed_area_km2, " km²"
    )
  ) |>
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c("Sawlog zone (formula-derived)",
                       "Pulpwood zone (formula-derived)",
                       "Biomass zone (fixed radius)"),
    options       = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )

sheds_wgs  <- st_transform(sheds, 4326) |> select(mill_id, mill_name)
sheds_json <- geojsonsf::sf_geojson(sheds_wgs)

m <- m |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender(paste0("
    function(el, x) {
      var map = this;
      var shedsData = ", sheds_json, ";
      var shedLayer = null;
      var activeMillId = null;

      function clearShed() {
        if (shedLayer) {
          map.removeLayer(shedLayer);
          shedLayer = null;
          activeMillId = null;
        }
      }

      map.on('click', function(e) {
        // Clicking the basemap (not a marker) clears the highlighted shed.
        clearShed();
      });

      map.eachLayer(function(layer) {
        if (layer.options && layer.options.layerId &&
            String(layer.options.layerId).startsWith('mill_')) {

          layer.on('click', function(ev) {
            var millId = String(layer.options.layerId).replace('mill_', '');

            // Second click on the same mill toggles the shed off.
            if (activeMillId === millId) {
              clearShed();
              return;
            }

            clearShed();
            activeMillId = millId;

            var match = shedsData.features.filter(function(f) {
              return String(f.properties.mill_id) === millId;
            });

            if (match.length === 0) {
              return; // mill has no shed (e.g. dropped from OSRM step)
            }

            shedLayer = L.geoJSON({type: 'FeatureCollection', features: match}, {
              style: {
                color: '#1f78ff',
                weight: 3,
                fillColor: '#1f78ff',
                fillOpacity: 0.15
              }
            }).addTo(map);

            map.fitBounds(shedLayer.getBounds(), {maxZoom: 11});
          });
        }
      });
    }
  "))

m
